name: tinkerscope
description: The tinkerscope browser playground for Tinker training-run checkpoints, plus the skills for driving it.

plugins.name: tinkerscope
plugins.description: Skills for tinkerscope — a local browser playground that auto-discovers Tinker training runs and is drivable from the terminal. `cli` teaches an agent to drive it with `tinkpg`; `guide` explains the browser UI to a human. Install the tool itself with `uv tool install git+https://github.com/Butanium/tinkerscope`.
